Hi Marissa / Sean —

Thanks for the follow-ups and for sending the SOC 2 packet. We've had the security team review the summary and the full report. A couple of quick items they flagged as needing clarification before we can proceed:

1) Encryption at rest: can you confirm whether customer data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK) or provider-managed keys? Our policy prefers CMK for production data.
2) Data retention & deletion: the summary references retention configurable per-customer — can you share the retention APIs or the documented deletion workflow (how soon data is purged after deletion request)?

Neither looks like a hard blocker — we can get answers from your security/SE. Would prefer a short call to get these clarified. We can do Tue 4/6 10am PT (works for the team).
